How does it work?

Your GLP-1 works by slowing your stomach down. Slow it too far and food stops moving into the intestines on schedule, and everything downstream backs up. The problem is at the top, so that is where Motilli works:

✓ Celery Apigenin concentrated from celery juice, supports your stomach’s natural movement, right where your GLP-1 slows things down

✓ Low-Viscosity Soluble Fiber that dissolves completely and holds water in the stool without adding bulk

✓ Chlorophyll Complex to neutralize the sulfur gas behind the burps, at the source

Food that sits ferments: the days without going, the sulfur burps, the cement-stomach bloat. Laxatives and fiber work on the colon, the bottom, six feet downstream from where any of it starts.

How long until I see a difference?

The sulfur burps usually fade first, inside the first week. The cement feeling starts lifting in weeks 2 to 3, with comfortable, unforced mornings coming back.

This is not an overnight fix. You are supporting a stomach your medication has been slowing for months. We recommend the full 8 to 12 weeks, and our 90-day money-back guarantee covers the entire 90-day reset, so you can judge it risk-free.

Each bottle lasts 30 days at 2 gummies a day. Mornings get steadier around week 6, and the reset builds over the full 90 days.

How do I take it?

Take 2 gummies before bed with a full glass of water. On injection weeks, the night before your shot matters most, so keep the ritual.

Heart-shaped and pre-dissolved. Nothing to swallow, no powders to mix, no timing around meals.

Can I keep taking my GLP-1 with this?

Yes. Motilli is made to be taken alongside your shot, not instead of it. Keep taking your GLP-1 exactly as prescribed.

The weight comes off because your medication quiets your appetite. The gut slowdown is a side effect riding along beside it. Motilli supports your stomach’s natural movement, so you keep the appetite control and the weight loss, without the backup, the burps, and the bloat. You never have to choose between the shot and your gut.
